## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Website Design & Modern Web Development
- **Overview**: Foxi Tech crafts ultra-fast, mobile-first, conversion-optimized websites using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. Every site is engineered to rank on search engines, load in under 1.5 seconds, and drive visitor inquiries.
- **Deliverables**:
  - Custom UI/UX design tailored to the client's brand.
  - Fully responsive layout for smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
  - On-page technical SEO (JSON-LD schema markup, OpenGraph tags, semantic HTML5, sitemap.xml, robots.txt).
  - Integrated WhatsApp click-to-chat and instant contact forms.
  - Full source code ownership transferred to the client upon completion.
- **Turnaround**: 3 to 12 business days depending on tier.

### 2. Google Business Profile & Local SEO
- **Overview**: Complete Google Maps 3-Pack optimization designed to make local service businesses rank at the top of local search queries.
- **Deliverables**:
  - Full Google Business Profile (GBP) audit, category selection, and keyword-rich description.
  - High-converting visual branding (storefront photos, team banners, service menus).
  - Proprietary 50-review collection system and NFC/QR review kit.
  - Local citation creation and NAP (Name, Address, Phone) synchronization across major business directories.
  - Geotagged image optimization and local landing page integration.

### 3. Meta & Google Ads Performance Marketing
- **Overview**: High-ROI paid advertising campaigns that drive immediate phone calls, WhatsApp inquiries, and qualified consultation bookings.
- **Deliverables**:
  - Hyper-local Google Search ad campaigns targeting high-intent buyer keywords.
  - Targeted Meta (Instagram & Facebook) lead generation ads with custom creative assets.
  - Conversion tracking and pixel setup.
  - Negative keyword management to eliminate wasted ad spend.
  - Direct inquiry routing to the client's WhatsApp and CRM.

### 4. Custom Software & Web Application Development
- **Overview**: End-to-end full-stack software development for businesses needing custom workflows, internal portals, client dashboards, or SaaS applications.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Tailwind CSS, Node.js, REST & GraphQL APIs.
- **Deliverables**:
  - Role-based authentication (Client, Admin, Staff).
  - Secure database design with Row Level Security (RLS).
  - Automated PDF agreement generation and electronic signature workflows.
  - Real-time notification systems and third-party API integrations.

### 5. AI Voice Agents & Business Automation
- **Overview**: Autonomous AI outbound calling and appointment automation integrating Indian multilingual speech models (Sarvam AI).
- **Features**:
  - Instant callback within 2 minutes of an inquiry submission.
  - Natural conversational flow in Indian English and Hindi.
  - Automated booking confirmation and calendar sync.
  - Call recording, transcript generation, and sentiment analysis for management review.

## Pricing & Engagement Model

Foxi Tech operates on a transparent, one-time flat fee model with **no recurring agency retainers**:
1. **Single Page Website**: ₹7,999 (One-time) — Live in 3 business days. Ideal for solo professionals, local service providers, and single-offering businesses.
2. **Static Multi-Page Website**: ₹14,999 (One-time) — Live in 7 business days. Includes 5 custom pages, free Google Business Profile setup, and Instagram launch kit.
3. **Dynamic Website & Booking System**: ₹24,999 (One-time) — Live in 10-12 business days. Full CMS/Admin dashboard, 24/7 appointment booking, payment gateway integration, and automated customer notifications.

Clients retain 100% ownership of their domain, code, and creative assets.
